text.title: C4 Drift Detection from IaC — Output Contract
text.summary: The drift report is one JSON document with one section per rule in 01-core-rules.xml: the machine-readable C4 model and its commit, the applied-state source and its identity (Terraform serial and lineage, Pulumi export version, CloudFormation stack id), the compared level, the versioned mapping table and allowlist with suppressed counts, the run trigger and cadence, findings in exactly three classes with both ids and a closure, the unmapped residue, and a reconciliation of state resources. Subagent MUST satisfy this contract before returning to caller.

required.field: the system whose C4 model and infrastructure are compared
format (Structurizr DSL or JSON, LikeC4, model YAML or JSON), path and commit; never a picture (r-c4-model-machine-readable)

tool, the applied-state source read (terraform show -json, pulumi stack export, DescribeStackResources) and the state identity per tool (r-compare-applied-state-not-source, r-run-on-apply-and-on-schedule)
container or system-context; component is not claimable from IaC (r-comparison-level-stated)
path and commit of the resource-type to C4-element mapping (r-mapping-table-versioned)
path, commit and the count suppressed per entry; hardcoded_skips_in_script false (r-noise-allowlist-explicit)
trigger post-apply or schedule, timestamp, and a cadence of at least weekly (r-run-on-apply-and-on-schedule)

each with id, class added / removed / edge-changed, iac_address, c4_element_id, closure (model-commit, iac-change, accepted with reason and expiry, or open) and reports_open (r-three-drift-classes-with-ids, r-finding-closes-by-commit-or-expiry)
resource types absent from the mapping table with counts; empty when none (r-mapping-table-versioned)
findings open across two consecutive reports; empty when none (r-finding-closes-by-commit-or-expiry)
URLs: the comparison run, the mapping table and allowlist at their commits, the previous report

forbidden.pattern: c4_model.format of png, drawio, miro or any rendering (fm-picture-as-canonical-model)
iac_state.source reading HCL, a Pulumi program or a template file, or a report with no state serial / export version / stack id (fm-diff-against-source-not-state)
comparison_level component, or findings whose c4_element_id sits inside a container (fm-component-level-from-iac)
unmapped absent, or reconciliation that does not sum to state_resources_total (fm-unmapped-silently-dropped)
allowlist.hardcoded_skips_in_script true, or a suppressed entry with no printed count (fm-noise-flood-or-hidden-skip)
a finding with a description but no iac_address or c4_element_id, or a class outside the three
closure accepted without reason or expiry, or a finding with reports_open of 2 or more absent from escalated_finding_ids (fm-findings-never-close)
run.cadence monthly or longer, or no post-apply trigger wired

allowed-transformations.transformation: Where a finding's expected C4 element does not exist yet (class added), record c4_element_id as the id the model commit will introduce, prefixed expected:.
Group several resources that form one C4 container (a service plus its task definition and target group) under one finding whose iac_address lists them.
Report edge-changed findings derived from security groups, IAM policies, peering, network policies or queue subscriptions with the source of the edge named in the description.

list.item: c4_model is a machine-readable format at a commit; iac_state.source is an applied-state command and identity carries the serial and lineage, export version, or stack id and last-updated time.
comparison_level is container or system-context; no finding's element id sits inside a container.
mapping_table and allowlist are version-controlled at a commit; every suppressed entry prints its count; no skips live in the script.
The run is wired post-apply and scheduled at least weekly.
Every finding has one of the three classes, an iac_address and a c4_element_id, and a closure that is a commit, an accepted entry with reason and expiry, or open.
allowlisted + mapped + unmapped equals state_resources_total; every unmapped type is listed with its count.
Every finding with reports_open of 2 or more is in escalated_finding_ids.
